name: DQR — Capturar candidato
description: Envia o perfil aberto no LinkedIn (ou no Recruiter) para o DQRManagement em um clique: analisa, avisa duplicatas e cria o candidato.
_oauth2_comment: client_id: OAuth client of type 'Chrome Extension' in Google Cloud Console, bound to THIS extension's id. It must match ExtensionAuth:GoogleClientId on the server, which pins it as the token's audience. Leave it empty and the Google button simply stays hidden — e-mail + password keeps working.
